21Z121Z1/XDRemux.body:
# XDRemux

[English](https://github.com/21Z121Z1/XDRemux/blob/HEAD/README.en.md) | 简体中文

XDRemux converts supported manufacturer HDR photos to ISO/TS 21496-1 HDR HEIC, and converts supported Android Motion Photos to Apple Live Photos.

The product has only one entry point: the Rust `xdremux` CLI. Input type, source generation, HDR / Gain Map structure, and Motion Photo routing are all automatically identified by the program.

## What It Can Do

| Input / Intent | Result |
| --- | --- |
| ProXDR Photos | ISO/TS 21496-1 HDR HEIC |
| Supported Motion Photos | Apple Live Photo HEIC + MOV |
| `--oppo-compatible` | ProXDR output for OPPO Gallery |
| `categorize` / `batch --categorize` | Categorize by asset type and capture mode |
| `inspect` / `validate` | Inspect source files and independently validate output |

Normal conversion does not require users to select device generation, codec, Gain Map layout, camera tail, or routing. These are all implementation details automatically determined by the program based on input facts and expected results.

## Building

The cross-platform conversion stack requires the current Rust toolchain and libheif with HEVC support.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/21Z121Z1/XDRemux.git
cd XDRemux
cargo build --release -p xdremux-cli
./target/release/xdremux --help
```

During development, you can also run directly through Cargo:

```bash
cargo run -p xdremux-cli -- --help
```

## Conversion

Standard ProXDR conversion:

```bash
xdremux convert \
  --input IMG_001.heic \
  --output IMG_001_hdr.heic
```

Supported Motion Photos use the same command, and the program automatically identifies them:

```bash
xdremux convert --input IMG_001.jpg
```

Motion Photo will generate a HEIC + MOV Live Photo resource pair with the same basename, and the source Motion Photo will not be modified.

FTShare-Lab/agent-claim-network.body:
ACN · Agent Claim Network

A general-purpose AI assistant running in the terminal.
When used by a single person, it's a complete assistant; when multiple people connect, the judgments each person has accumulated can form a searchable, traceable network.

Developed by Non-convex ft.tech

In this demonstration, the current Agent discovers that western revenue in the sales details hasn't been filled back, and through the team's Router service, retrieves two reusable Claims (judgments) that another Agent has accumulated: data is only complete after 09:30, and totals with missing fields must be marked as "provisional"; the Agent then modifies the daily report according to these team standards and displays the file diff.

To view the team collaboration interface, see Web Interface Preview; the page uses a simulated server and fictional data.

Overview

Run acn and describe tasks in natural language: look up information, modify files, run commands, view images and PDFs, and integrate external tools. Commands execute on your local machine, and changes are displayed as diffs. This layer is similar to common terminal coding agents, but isn't limited to writing code—it's a general-purpose assistant instead.

The other layer is Claims. When compressing context or ending a session, ACN reviews conclusions from this round that are solid and reusable in the future, and records them as judgments with applicable scopes and reasoning. When used by a single person, you won't need to repeat questions next time; when multiple people connect their ACN instances to the same team service, these judgments can see each other, reference each other, and be challenged—flowing together and forming a Network. Private Memory still belongs only to the current Agent; what's shared in the team is Claims with holders.

Team services (Router, Maintainer) are two other executables in this repository, deployed as needed. When both addresses are left empty, it's single-person mode: full functionality, just not connected to team services.

[!WARNING]
ACN executes commands and reads/writes files on your machine—it's not a sandbox. stdio-type MCP servers also inherit ACN process permissions. Please use it in trusted working directories and only connect trusted tools.

What It Can Do

  • Streaming conversation; attach text/images/PDFs with @path; paste images with Ctrl+V, preview with Ctrl+O
  • Interrupt mid-run with Ctrl+Enter; subsequent input queues without disrupting the current round
  • Long-running commands can move to the background, view or stop them in /ps
  • File changes show as diffs directly, without being fed back to the model context
  • acn --resume resumes historical sessions; can also search what it said in old sessions
  • After /exit, review happens in the background and the terminal is returned immediately

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
npx cap open ios
```

If you're only renewing the signing without changing content, you don't need to rebuild the web artifacts.

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22.22.2

npx cap open ios
```

# 1c-quality-gate

**Code quality control for 1C development paired with a language model.** Editing a `.bsl` file or metadata XML arms a gate: in Claude Code you cannot end the session until the check has been run; in OpenCode the plugin persistently returns the agent to unchecked edits. Depth is automatically calculated: a cosmetic fix closes in seconds, while a transaction or new common module requires a full review. The result is a report with findings and a machine-readable trace showing what was checked, what was skipped, and why.

> **English.** A Claude Code and OpenCode plugin that enforces code-quality checks for 1C:Enterprise (BSL) development. Editing a BSL module or a metadata XML arms a session gate: in Claude Code a `Stop` hook refuses to end the session until the quality run has happened; OpenCode has no such mechanism, so the plugin keeps returning the agent to the unchecked edits instead. SYNTEC-40101720/syntec-macro.body:
# SYNTEC Macro Program VS Code Extension

Provides syntax highlighting, completion, hover documentation, code navigation, and real-time diagnostics for SYNTEC macro programs (syntec-macro).

## Quick Start

Open or create one of the following files:

- G/O programs without extension, for example `G1000`, `O8000`
- Machining files such as `.nc`, `.cnc`, `.tap`, `.prt`, `.mpf`, `.ptp`
- Files with `%@MACRO` on the first line will be automatically recognized as MACRO format

Example:

```macro
%@MACRO
#1 := 100;
#2 := 200;

IF #1 < #2 THEN
    #3 := #2 - #1;
    MSG("Result ready");
END_IF;
```

If the language is not automatically recognized, click the language mode in the bottom-right corner and select **SYNTEC Macro Program**.

## Common Features

| Feature | Usage |
| --- | --- |
| Completion | Type functions, keywords, G/M codes, or `#`, or press `Ctrl+Space` |
| Hover Documentation | Move your mouse over functions, G/M codes, or keywords |
| Go to Definition | `Ctrl+Click` to jump to N labels, G65/G66, M98/M198 targets |
| Find References | Press `Shift+F12` on static call targets |
| Symbol Navigation | `Ctrl+Shift+O` to view N labels and macro entry points |
| Workspace Symbols | `Ctrl+T` to search G/O programs, macro entry points, and N labels |
| Formatting | Right-click and select "Format Document" |

Supported robot instructions include `MOVJ`, `MOVL`, `MOVC`, `USERCOR`, `TOOLCOR`, `SKIP`, `SWAITSIG`, `SYNCOUT`, etc.

## Configuration

Search for `syntecMacro` in VS Code settings:

| Configuration Item | Default Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `syntecMacro.enableDiagnostics` | `true` | Enable real-time syntax diagnostics |
| `syntecMacro.enableCompletions` | `true` | Enable completion |
| `syntecMacro.enableHover` | `true` | Enable hover documentation |
| `syntecMacro.includePath` | `[]` | Additional search directories for G65/G66 targets |

For example:

```json
{
  "syntecMacro.includePath": [
    "C:\\CNC\\MACROS",
    "D:\\PROJECTS\\COMMON"
  ]
}
```

Target files are typically searched according to the following rules: `G65 P1000` corresponds to `G1000`, `M98`…

# 📅 Schedule Plugin

## Introduction

**Schedule Plugin** is a schedule management plugin based on [Yunzai-Bot V3](https://github.com/TimeRainStarSky/Yunzai). It supports one-click import of schedules via ~~WakeUp schedule commands~~, Xinglink schedule commands, JSON files (supporting both the plugin's native format and export files from [ShiGuang Schedule](https://github.com/XingHeYuZhuan/shiguangschedule)), ICS files, and Wakeup backup files. It also provides practical features such as schedule query, viewing classmates' class status, schedule push subscription, schedule export, and quick schedule adjustment.

The plugin also includes a built-in birthday module that supports members setting their birthdays and automatically receiving birthday wishes. The birthday module supports per-group configuration, allowing you to freely control which groups can receive push notifications.

> 🚀 **Almost zero configuration, ready to use out of the box!**

---

> [!CAUTION]
> **Urgently stop using WakeUp Schedule!**
>
> WakeUp has recently conducted two absurd operations that have made it impossible for this plugin to import schedules via commands:
>
> **Early April**: Migrated the schedule request API and added authentication. Developers attempted to temporarily solve it through a reverse proxy service.
>
> **April 29**: Further strengthened authentication, requests were directly blocked and returned **"hit anti-cheat"**.
>
> This behavior of deliberately blocking third-party access and even mocking developers with "anti-cheat" not only causes data monopolization but also betrays the open spirit that a schedule tool should have. Meanwhile, WakeUp's advertisements keep increasing, gradually becoming an annoying ad platform.
>
> **For your user experience and data autonomy, we recommend migrating to other schedule software as soon as possible, such as [ShiGuang Schedule](https://github.com/XingHeYuZhuan/shiguangschedule) or Xinglink Schedule.**
>
> **Migration method**: Share your schedule in WakeUp, export it as a calendar file or backup file, then import the schedule data through the `#import schedule` command. After that, you can export a JSON file compatible with ShiGuang Schedule through the `#export ShiGuang schedule` command.
>
> This plugin has urgently adapted to JSON import (supporting ShiGuang export format) and Xinglink schedule command import, so please use it with confidence.

---

# 🪪 Hong Kong Immigration Department Appointment Quota Monitoring

Real-time tracking of Hong Kong Immigration Department **ID Card Replacement** appointment quota, with automatic notifications via **Feishu Group + Feishu Private Chat** when new quota is released.

---

## 📱 Method 1: Join Feishu Group (Recommended)

Bot automatically pushes quota changes, **instant message delivery**, ready to use upon joining the group, no configuration needed.

> 📖 **[Group Info & How to Join](https://scn7uo58gnuo.feishu.cn/wiki/QSFlwcMBmil7sGkZRBTcAWqwnCf)** (Multiple group options, automatic distribution when groups are full)

### 💬 Method 2: Feishu Private Chat Subscription

If you don't want to join a group, you can also **filter by date** and only receive notifications for dates you care about:

1. [Message bot "HKID Quota Auto-detection"](https://applink.feishu.cn/T98uc8RbxI8c) (send any message to trigger)
2. Bot will reply with an interactive card supporting:
   - 📅 **Subscribe to Specific Dates** — only focus on the day of your appointment
   - 🔔 **Subscribe to All Dates** — get notified for all quota releases
   - 📊 **View / Modify / Cancel Subscription**
3. You can also reply with dates directly for one-click subscription, e.g. `08/15, 08/20-08/25`

Supports three filtering modes:
- 📅 **By Date** — view specific dates only, no office restrictions
- 🏢 **By Office** — view specific offices only, no date restrictions
- 🎯 **By Date + Office** — exact matching

> 💡 Bot private chat has 1-2 second latency; if urgent, joining the group is recommended.

---

## 🖥 Dashboard

> 🖥 **[quota-monitor Dashboard](https://Zheyi-D.github.io/quota-monitor)**

- 📊 Real-time view of appointment quota status across all Hong Kong offices
- 📈 Quota release pattern heatmap, visualizing release frequency by time period
- 📖 Includes phone appointment tutorial
- 🔧 Built-in admin panel supporting subscriber management, statistics overview, and dual-channel broadcast

---

## 📨 Notification Flow

When new quota is detected, notifications are sent in the following order:

> **Group Chat Broadcast** (multiple groups in parallel) → **Private Chat DM** (in parallel, only sent to subscribers matching the date)

Feishu group and private chat messages arrive almost simultaneously.

---

## 🔒 Privacy & Security

- Feishu user data stored with **AES-256-GCM encryption**, not readable in repository
- Only reads quota data **publicly released** by Immigration Department
- ⚠️ Disclaimer: This system is a third-party open-source tool, not an official service of Hong Kong Immigration Department; please refer to official website information

# HumanEval Model Evaluation Tool

Tool based on OpenAI HumanEval benchmark to evaluate the code generation capability of large language models.

## Project Structure

```
.
├── evaluate_models.py     # Evaluation script (supports full/quick/custom tests)
├── results/               # Evaluation results output directory
├── requirements.txt       # Dependency list
└── README.md
```

## Quick Start

### 1. Install Dependencies

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

### 2. Quick Verification (5 problems)

Run 5 problems first to verify that the generation + evaluation process is working correctly:

```bash
python evaluate_models.py \
    --api-type anthropic \
    --base-url YOUR_BASE_URL \
    --api-key YOUR_API_KEY \
    --models model-name \
    --quick
```

### 3. Full Evaluation (164 problems)

After verification passes, run all 164 problems:

```bash
python evaluate_models.py \
    --api-type anthropic \
    --base-url YOUR_BASE_URL \
    --api-key YOUR_API_KEY \
    --models model1 model2 model3 \
    --max-tokens 32768
```

**Please check the following before using this API.**

- **This is unofficial.** It has no relation to the official BOATRACE website or related organizations.
- **Not real-time.** Updates occur approximately every 3 minutes via GitHub Actions, so there may be a delay of several minutes before the latest information is reflected.

This API allows you to retrieve boatrace (powerboat racing) data. The data is published on GitHub Pages and provided in JSON format.

| Item | Details |

Coverage period: **From January 1, 2026 onwards**

```bash
https://boatraceopenapi.github.io/api/v1/YYYY/YYYYMMDD.json
```

- `YYYY` → year
- `YYYYMMDD` → year-month-day

mbm110/MSN-GUARD.body: # MSN-GUARD **Full-device tunneling for censored networks — Five transport routes, Rust core, native Android interface** **Persian** · [English](https://github.com/mbm110/MSN-GUARD/blob/HEAD/README.en.md) --- ## Introduction MSN-GUARD is a native Android VPN client that routes all device traffic through five independent paths. The difference from proxy apps is that they typically only cover the browser; here the work is done at the level of Android's own `VpnService`. In other words, a TUN interface is created and every TCP, UDP, and QUIC packet — from any app installed on the phone — passes through the tunnel. The application structure has two components. A network core written in Rust that implements the protocols itself and negotiates with the gateway, and a Kotlin layer that handles the VPN lifecycle, user interface, and platform-specific tasks. The last two routes — Psiphon and Tor — have their own cores and connect to the same TUN through local SOCKS. There is no intermediary server on our side in the middle; the phone communicates directly with the upstream gateway. What sets this project apart from a general app is this: it was designed for Iranian networks, and every protocol choice you see in it comes from real measurements on domestic operators, not from assumptions or documentation. racheko-lab/blive-monitor.body:
# 📡 Bilibili/Douyin Live Stream Monitoring + Multi-Channel Push Notifications

A lightweight live stream status monitoring tool that supports Bilibili and Douyin platforms. When going live or publishing new works, it automatically pushes notifications through multiple channels (Bark / Server酱 / Wecom / PushPlus / Telegram).

## ✨ Features

- 🎬 **Multi-platform Support**: Monitor Bilibili and Douyin live streams simultaneously
- 🔔 **Multi-Channel Push Notifications**: Send notifications through Bark / Server酱 / Wecom / PushPlus / Telegram when going live or publishing new works
- 📊 **Live Stream Duration Statistics**: Record stream duration and last broadcast time
- 📝 **History Logs**: Keep the latest 200 status change records
- 🔄 **Merged Notifications**: Merge multiple broadcasters' notifications into one when going live simultaneously
- 📱 **Responsive Page**: Mobile-friendly monitoring page
- 🎵 **New Works Detection**: Support for detecting new works published on Douyin (optional)

## 📋 Quick Start

### 1. Configure Monitored Rooms

Edit the `rooms.json` file and add the broadcasters you want to monitor:

```json
[
  {
    "platform": "bilibili",
    "id": "1874913653",
    "name": "峰哥亡命天涯"
  },
  {
    "platform": "douyin",
    "id": "83134194400",
    "name": "27～"
  }
]
```

**Field Description:**
- `platform`: Platform, `bilibili` or `douyin`
- `id`: Live stream room ID
  - Bilibili: Room number (the numbers in the URL, e.g., `https://live.bilibili.com/1874913653`)
  - Douyin: Live stream web_rid (the string in the URL, e.g., `https://live.douyin.com/83134194400`)
- `name`: Broadcaster name (used for display and push notifications)

### 2. Configure Push Channels (Optional)

Live stream / new works notifications support multiple channels, configured through the environment variable `BLIVE_CONFIG` (JSON):

```bash
# Bark (iPhone, recommended)
export BLIVE_CONFIG='{"push": {"type": "bark", "url": "https://api.day.app/your_key", "group": "blive"}}'

# Or Wecom group robot (free and unlimited, recommended)
export BLIVE_CONFIG='{"push": {"type": "wecom", "webhook": "https://qyapi.weixin.qq.com/cgi-bin/webhook/send?key=xxxx"}}'

# Or…
```

rulego/gflow-engine.body:
# GFlow Engine

[English](https://github.com/rulego/gflow-engine/blob/HEAD/README_EN.md) | Simplified Chinese

> **GFlow** —— AI pre-review · then human signing · auto-process after signing

`GFlow Engine` is a lightweight, embeddable approval workflow engine based on [RuleGo](https://github.com/rulego/rulego). Process definitions reuse the `RuleGo` rule chain DSL (JSON). Approval tasks, process instances, history archives and other statuses are persisted to a relational database by the engine, eliminating the need to deploy independent process middleware. Approval nodes and automation nodes (rule chains, HTTP, AI agents, sub-processes) are freely mixed in the same process DSL — subsequent actions are automatically executed after approval; OR-sign, AND-sign, dynamic add/remove signers, rejection and other Chinese-style approval semantics are available out-of-the-box.

> Note: DSL is a JSON-format BPMN-like approval flow; it does not parse BPMN 2.0 XML.

## Features

* **Chinese-style approval semantics, out-of-the-box**: OR-sign, AND-sign, voting sign (majority/percentage/specified number of votes), sequential approval, dynamic add/remove signers, reassign, delegate, sign/claim, reject, withdraw, timeout reminder, no secondary development required; process definitions support multiple versions coexisting, legacy instances continue to completion according to the version at startup.
* **Approval and automation in one workflow**: Process DSL reuses `RuleGo` rule chains, approval nodes can be freely orchestrated with conditional branches, parallel branches, rule chains, HTTP calls, AI agents, and sub-processes — subsequent actions are automatically executed after approval (such as accounting, notifications, writing back to business systems).
* **Embeddable host, identity and permissions controlled by host**: Pure Go library integration, not tied to any user system; approvers are resolved by personnel/role/department/multi-level managers (`IdentityService`); permissions are validated for each operation, full-path multi-tenant isolation.
* **Lightweight and reliable**: No external middleware like message queues needed; PostgreSQL / MySQL out-of-the-box (dialects can be extended to DM, Kingbase etc.); runtime/history dual-table separation, audit reports don't impact production; 17 task event hooks drive notifications and other side effects ([docs/events.md](https://github.com/rulego/gflow-engine/blob/HEAD/docs/events.md)).

## GFlow Platform (Enterprise Edition)

**GFlow Platform** is an out-of-the-box approval workflow platform built on GFlow Engine (i.e., GFlow Enterprise Edition), with complete front-end and back-end solutions:

- **Approval Center**: Initiate requests, pending / completed / CC'd to me, approval statistics, complete approval workflow out-of-the-box
- **Process Designer + Form Designer**: Business users drag-and-drop to build processes and forms, no coding required
- **AI Approval**: AI agents join the approval flow to complete document pre-review

wkbin/taixu.body:
TaiXu

Android No-Root Linux Runtime · AI Agent Harness · Visual Automation Workflows · Native PTY Terminal · Mobile Development Workspace

v0.15.1 stable · Android 10+ (API 29+) · arm64-v8a · Kotlin 2.4.10 · Jetpack Compose

Simplified Chinese · English

--- ## 🌌 What is TaiXu From the Liezi · Questions of Tang: "East of the Bohai Sea... within it there is a great ravine, which is truly a bottomless valley. Below it there is no bottom, named Guixu. The waters of the Eight Poles and Nine Wilds, the flow of the Milky Way—all flow into it without increase or decrease." **TaiXu** draws inspiration from this: within Android's application sandbox and permission boundaries, establish a realm of Linux and AI automation that is **runnable, observable, recoverable, and evolvable**. It is not simply layering a chat interface atop a large model, nor merely a terminal emulator. TaiXu enables Agents, MCP tools, Linux processes, native PTY, browsers, Git, and project workspaces to share an execution context; visual workflows extend a single conversation into persistent, approvable, and schedulable automation tasks. You can begin from a natural language intent and ultimately obtain real files, running processes, verified code, or installable Android / Flutter build artifacts. > At TaiXu establish the center; within a square inch, create worlds. ```text Human Intent ─→ Agent Planning ─→ Linux / Tools / MCP / Browser / Host Capabilities ─→ Validation & Delivery ↑ ↓ └──────────── If incomplete, continue; approve when necessary ──────────────┘ Persistent Workflows ─→ Conditional Branches / Parallel Nodes / Scheduled Tasks / Background Execution / Manual Approval ``` --- ## ⚡ Core Capabilities | Domain | Capabilities Overview | | :--- | :--- | | **Linux Runtime** | Run ARM64 Linux on non-root Android based on **PRoot**; install and verify RootFS from OCI Registry, supporting coexistence of multiple distributions, switching, rollback, persistent directory binding, and mounting to Android shared storage. | | **Agent Harness** | Support OpenAI-compatible Chat…

xmgzxmgz/workbuddy-account-hub.body:
# WorkBuddy Account Hub

> 🌟 **Key highlight: instant account switching, ultra-simple operation.** Have multiple WorkBuddy accounts on your machine? Switch between them with one click—switching only changes your "login identity" without touching any of your local data, and conversations for each account remain independent and fully preserved. See the implementation details below at [How It Works](#how-it-works-why-switching-accounts-doesnt-lose-your-conversations).

> A **locally-running** cross-platform (macOS / Windows) desktop application that centralizes daily WorkBuddy account operations in one window:
> **Ultra-fast multi-account switching, multi-account billing quotas (three official APIs), daily check-in, pet adventure and energy blind boxes, login state management, AI memory profile, API model management (including global privacy data obfuscation)**.
> Built with Tauri 2 + Rust, pure local data flow, no cloud dependencies.

> ⚠️ **Security Statement**: This application only reads the login state already saved by your local WorkBuddy client (`workbuddy-desktop.info`), will not ask you for account passwords, and will not upload any credentials to third parties other than official APIs.
> **Please only run on machines you trust, and do not commit files containing login state to any repository.**

---

## 🌟 Core Advantages

**In one sentence: when switching between multiple accounts, your conversation history never gets lost; see all accounts' point balances in one window.**

Many people use multiple WorkBuddy accounts simultaneously (work account / side account / test account), but the official client can only log in to one at a time. When switching back and forth, people fear "previous conversations disappearing" most, and even more fear "having to log in separately to check how much balance each account has left". WorkBuddy Account Hub solves both problems at the architecture level:

- ⚡ **Instant switching**: The sidebar lists all accounts you've ever logged into on your machine (including ones you've never manually backed up), click once to switch, and WorkBuddy automatically restarts to take effect.
- 💾 **Zero local data changes**: Switching only changes your "login identity", never modifies WorkBuddy's session database. Conversations for each account are isolated by uid and fully preserved independently.
- 📊 **Multi-account quota overview**: Each account uses its own login state to query the official billing API, gift packages / trial version / total remaining, expiration time, usage rate all visible on one screen—the official dashboard can only show the currently logged-in account.
- 🛡 **Automatic backup**: Before each switch, the hub automatically backs up the "account you're about to leave" including its entire login state + local_storage into the local vault, so even in extreme cases you can restore it.
- 🔁 **Reversible switching**: The switchable account list only grows, never shrinks. Switch between multiple accounts freely, go back and forth without worry—no "once switched, can't come back" issues.

Want to know how it works under the hood? See the [How It Works](#how-it-works-why-switching-accounts-doesnt-lose-your-conversations) section below.

---

## ✨ Feature Overview

| Module | Capability | Status |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **🌟 Ultra-fast multi-account switching** | List all accounts you've logged into on your machine, one-click switching with **100% conversation history preserved** (only changes login state, including pinned status migration)…

yafoo/menote.body:
# MeNote

MeNote is a lightweight personal note-taking knowledge base system that supports Markdown notes, category management, bidirectional links, and knowledge graphs. It has built-in P2P tunneling, allowing mobile apps to connect directly to the note service on your NAS without requiring a public IP. Data is stored locally with privacy fully under your control.

## Features

- **Markdown Editor**: Based on Vditor, supports real-time preview, syntax highlighting, tables, task lists, and more
- **Category Management**: Tree-structured category system with drag-and-drop sorting
- **Knowledge Graph**: Note association visualization based on vis-network
- **P2P Remote Access**: Direct access to your knowledge base on your home computer from mobile/external networks via iroh QUIC tunneling
- **RESTful API**: Complete category/note CRUD interface with Token authentication support
- **Mobile Adaptation**: Responsive design for management dashboard, single-column stack view for mobile

## Tech Stack

- **Backend**: Node.js v20 + [jj.js](https://github.com/yafoo/jj.js) framework (Koa 3 subclass) + SQLite
- **Frontend**: Vue 3 + Element Plus + Vditor + vis-network
- **P2P**: [@number0/iroh](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@number0/iroh) 1.1.0 (QUIC bidirectional streams)
- **Android**: Kotlin + WebView + iroh-android FFI

## Quick Start

### Requirements

- Node.js >= 20.19
- npm >= 10

### Installation

```bash
npm install
```

### Getting Started

The first launch will enter an installation wizard where you can configure the admin account as prompted:

```bash
npm start
```

The service listens on port **3107** by default. Open `http://localhost:3107` in your browser to access it.

### Docker

#### Single Container Launch

```bash
docker run -d \
  --name menote \
  -p 3107:3107 \
  -v $(pwd)/config:/menote/config \
  -v $(pwd)/data:/menote/data \
  -v $(pwd)/upload:/menote/public/upload \
  yafoo/menote:latest
```

**Important**: You must mount two volumes:
- `data/` — SQLite database, P2P private keys, whitelist configuration
- `public/upload/` — User-uploaded attachments (images, documents, etc.)
